title: The Star’s Ego
excerpt: Twinkling star,  the one so far, Protons die to give you your light, Yet, you have not a single scar, And pretend to be a diamond of the night.
content:
Twinkling star,  the one so far,

Protons die to give you your light,

Yet, you have not a single scar,

And pretend to be a diamond of the night.
